{{Top|leg}}
'''Heavy plating type 3''' was the heaviest protection available for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and was highly uncommon due to the cost involved in production. It was best suited to specialized [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin]] or [[Battle droid/Legends|assault droids]], though such units were highly regulated.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
